purpose: Attribute reconstruction research only; none of these accuracy values is Transported accuracy or a competition score.
data: 12970 training/test roster rows; Transported excluded during CSV ingestion for every attribute-reconstruction model.
protocol: For each attribute, split known rows into stratified80% training/20% simulated masks with random_state20261112. Preserve original missingness in other predictors; do not restrict to complete rows. Raw attributes plus parsed Deck/Side/CabinNumber, excluding IDs, Name, attribute being predicted and its derived features.

existing_v34_development_error_coverage.note: Descriptive use of existing development OOF results, not a new target evaluation and not holdout scoring.

limitations: The attribute research uses around10000 known rows for training, whereas run029 fits its posterior only on known-HomePlanet rows in each outer training fold. These reconstruction numbers are not the formal candidate posterior's validation result.
Random-mask reconstruction and calibration need not transfer to the actually missing subpopulation or improve Transported predictions.
The proposed target objective is posterior-weighted complete-data logloss, not exact Bayesian observed-data marginal likelihood.
review_decision: One fixed HomePlanet-only candidate with consistent train/predict expansion, unit total weight per original row, existing spatial expert reuse, and observed-HomePlanet predictions unchanged. No Cryo, spending multi-imputation, SCARF or VIME candidate in this round.
